Commentary.Commentary: Right then. That's it from the coverage of this game and also the series. Babar Azam is handed the trophy, who is soon robbed by the rest of the pack. The team surrounds the trophy and pose for a picture. The celebrations have begun at Multan. At the end of the series, the hosts are placed fourth in the Super League standings, while West Indies remain on the fifth position. Pakistan have a handy break before they face Netherlands in their next series in August. West Indies, on the other hand, have an upcoming home series against Bangladesh which starts on 16th June. Although, there is plenty of cricketing action happening around. Until next time, take care and good bye!

Babar Azam, the victorious skipper is in for a chat. He says they executed the plan well and the results are coming their way. Adds that as a team, he felt the second ODI was their best win as they played as a team. Adds that Nawaz played really well and it was really vital, so that was his best performance. Shares that they tried the bench and played some experienced players as well, so, as a group, they are going forward. Mentions that improvement is needed every time and hopes to rectify the mistakes. On his form, he says he just tries to play positive cricket. He tries to play according to the conditions and wicket. He thanks the Multan crowd in the end.

Nicholas Pooran, the skipper of West Indies says the last two games were really disappointing. Mentions they learned a lot from this series. Adds, Hosein always keeps on telling us he is a batsman and he displayed it for all. Says, he is really proud of the guys for the way they have taken up such talent. Pooran ends by thanking the fans for their wonderful support over the last three games.

Imam-ul-Haq wins the MAN OF THE SERIES award for his consistent performances with the blade over the series. He says, he has been working on skills and such consistent performances only helps his confidence. Mentions the rapport with Azam helps a lot when the two are at the crease together. Ends by saying run outs are a part of the game but it was Azam's fault.

Shadab Khan wins the MAN OF THE MATCH award for his all-round performance. He starts by thanking the almighty. Mentions he is really happy to perform for his side both with the bat and ball, especially after coming in from an injury. Further adds he does not feel he was great with the ball but is glad to walk away with wickets.
Stay tuned for the presentation...

Earlier, Pakistan started well with the blade with Imam-ul-Haq scoring a half-century. It was all going well for them until, they started losing wickets at regular intervals after the first wicket stand was broke. They were teetering at 117/5 at one stage. Shadab Khan's incredible knock of 86 added some impetus to the scoreboard. If not for him, Pakistan would have been out of this game quite early on. Nicholas Pooran was the surprise package with 4 wickets but West Indies lost it at the death.

An excellent effort with the ball by Pakistan. Shahnawaz Dahani was the one to draw the first blood, also his first ODI wicket. The pacers did really well up top to kill the pace of the West Indies innings. In the middle overs, the spinners took advantage of the wicket and flourised with wickets at regular intervals. Shadab Khan was the star with the ball with his four-wicket haul. Every bowler chipped in with a wicket and a complete team performance gets them over the line convincingly. Earlier it was some good opening stand and some excellent finish from Shadab Khan helped them reach to a par score. It turned out to be enough as the bowlers did the job.

A bad day at the office for West Indies overall! The visitors started briskly with the blade. Even after losing Kyle Mayers early on, Brooks and Hope stabled the ship with their stand which brought hope back across the West Indies camp but it was not to be. The pair was sent back in a jiffy and since then Pakistan looked to be in the driving seat. Keacy Carty looked the brightest in the middle order for the men in maroon. Akeal Hosein's knock of 60 was a crucial one. He showed his side the light at the end of the tunnel but could not take them all the way. It looked like no batter is comfortable to spend time on the crease for West Indies and that took the game away from them.

Pakistan completes the whitewash and the crowd is up on their feet here in Multan. They dominated the proceedings with the ball, especially the spinners, and got over the line eventually. West Indies needed less than a run a ball but the lack of wickets in hand proved to be costly.

OUT! CAUGHT! Ali takes the last wicket! What a comprehensive win for the hosts! This is full and around off, in the slot. Shepherd looks to go downtown but is a touch late to his shot and fails to clear the long on fielder. Babar Azam there takes it with ease and Pakistan win the series 3-0. They win by 53 runs.
Commentary.Howout: c Babar Azam b Hasan Ali

Commentary.Commentary: A length ball on middle. Shepherd inner edges his push to square leg. He does not rotate the strike.
Tossed up on off. Seales dead bats it.
Floated ball, around off. Seales looks to flick it but misses and gets hit on the pads. Sliding down.
Jayden Seales is the last man in.

OUT! LBW! Khan gets his fourth wicket now! A proper leg-spinners delivery this! Full ball, landing around off and spinning in sharply. Walsh leans across to defend but misses and gets hit on the pads. An appeal for LBW and up goes the finger. Looked plumb but Hayden Walsh takes the review. UltraEdge shows no bat there. Ball Tracking shows impact is umpire's call although the wickets are hitting and that means the on-field decision stays.
A googly, full and outside off. Walsh looks to drive but misses.
Tossed up, on middle, turning away from Walsh who leans to tuck it away but misses and gets hit on the pads. An appeal but was going down.
On the pads, flicked to mid-wicket.
Leg bye! Tossed up, full and around off, turning in. Walsh prods to defend but misses and gets hit on the pads. It rolls to point for a leg bye. 54 needed now.
Shorter and outside off, cut to deep point for a single.
Too full and on middle. Walsh hits it back to Nawaz who fails to stop it and parries it behind for a single.
Flatter now, on middle, tucked to square leg for a single.
SIX! Massive! Full ball, in the slot on middle. Shepherd slog-sweeps it high over deep mid-wicket for a biggie. The hopes of win rely on Romario Shepherd now.
Flatter and drifting on middle. Shepherd punches it to covers.
Floated and full, on off. Walsh works it through covers for a brace.
Full and on off, defended out.
This one turn away from off. Walsh looks to chase it away but misses.
On off, blocked out.
Hayden Walsh comes in.

OUT! STUMPED! Akeal Hosein's valiant knock comes to an end. Some relief on the face of the Pakistani players after seeing the back of Hosein. He was certainly taking the game away. It is a googly around off. Akeal Hosein comes down the track and tries to defend it out but gets beaten by the turn. Mohammad Haris continues his good work behind the stumps and removed the bails in a flash.
Commentary.Howout: st Mohammad Haris b Shadab Khan

Commentary.Commentary: A stumping appeal! First the third umpire asks for the UltraEdge and no bat is there but the side angle shows Akeal Hosein is well out of his crease when the bails are moved.
SIX! THIS IS HUGE! Two fielders converge and collide beyond the ropes. It is full and on off. Akeal Hosein gets on one knee and slogs it over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
FOUR! Romario Shepherd joins the party now. Full length, on off. Romario Shepherd smokes it down the ground. One bounce into the ropes.
Loopy ball, full and on off. Romario Shepherd blocks it back to the bowler.
On off, punched through covers for one.
SIX! KABOOM! Akeal Hosein gets his fifty with two back-to-back sixes. Tossed up, full and outside off. Hosein uses his feet yet again and tonks it over the bowler's head for a biggie.
On off, Hosein works it to mid-wicket.
SIX! BANG! Akeal Hosein playing the anchor's role here. It is full, wide outside off. Hosein dances down the track and smokes it over the bowler's head for a maximum.
How has this missed the stumps! It is a length ball, around off, nips in a long way off the deck. Romario Shepherd swings hard but fails to get any bat on it. The ball passes over the pole.
Short and wide outside off. Hosein slaps it aerially through covers for one.

Leg bye! A length ball, angled in from outside off. This one hits Romario Shepherd on his thigh pads as he looks to swing it across the line. Wasim appeals but the umpire says no. Going down leg maybe. The batters collect a leg bye.
On a length, outside off. Hosein runs it down to third man for a single.
This one is on a length, outside off. Hosein pushes it to mid off.
Length ball, moving away a touch. Hosein works it to mid off.
Looped up, full and on off. Romario Shepherd blocks it back to the bowler on the front foot.
Fuller, on leg. Hosein tucks it to the leg side for one now.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Romario Shepherd gets it to mid-wicket off the inner half. They take one.
What a ripper! It is tossed up, around off. This one grips and turns away. Romario Shepherd tries to defend it inside the line and gets beaten.
Full and outside off. Hosein reaches out and cuts it through point for a single.
Around off, this one turns in off the deck. Akeal Hosein hangs back and clips it to the leg side.
Length ball, outside off. Romario Shepherd cracks it to covers but straight to the fielder.

A loud appeal for lbw but turned down! Mohammad Wasim is convinced he got his man and Babar Azam takes the review. The original decision is not out. This one lands on a length, around off and nips back in sharply off the deck. Romario Shepherd tries to punch it down the ground but misses. He gets pinged on his pads. Wasim appeals but the umpire disagrees. The Ball Tracking later shows that it is umpire's call on the ball hitting the stumps. Akeal Hosein is delighted after looking at the big screen.
Full length, outside off. Hosein drives it through covers for a single.
FOUR! A much-needed boundary for West Indies. It is touch short, around leg. Hosein glances it down to fine leg for a boundary.
WIDE! This one is sprayed down the leg side. Hosein fails to flick it away. Wided.
Goes full again, on off. Hosein tries to heave it across the line but fails to connect it cleanly.
Full length, on off. Hosein eases it to mid on.
Again no turn, this is outside off, it is hit back to Nawaz.
An arm ball, not much turn there, it is pushed to mid-wicket.
Slightly slow and around off. Shepherd strokes it to covers.
On the pads, flicked to deep square leg for a single.
Quicker, flatter and around middle and leg. Hosein punches it uppishly back to the bowler.
Around off, pushed to covers for a single.
FOUR! He is dealing with boundaries! This is short and around off, not that short but Hosein still pulls it hard, flat and over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Pushed quicker and on off. Hosein plays it to square leg.
Flatter and outside off. Romario Shepherd taps it to covers for a single.
Dropped! Tossed up, full and around off, it spins away. Romario Shepherd looks to slog-sweep it but gets an outside edge to first slip where Babar Azam drops a regulation catch.
Full and outside off, spinning away. Romario Shepherd has a wild sweep across the line but misses.
Flatter and outside off, knocked to point.
SIX! Well played! Too much flighted this time, full and on off. Hosein skips down and thumps it straight down for a biggie.
Fuller and on off. Shepherd drives it past the bowler to long off for a single.
Tossed up on middle. Blocked out.

DRINKS! West Indies need less than a run a ball and find themselves in a precarious position with only three wickets in hand. Pakistan currently dominating the proceedings with the ball. They would hope to get done with the business as soon as possible. Can West Indies stage a solid fight? Stay tuned to find out... Romario Shepherd is the new man to walk in with the blade for the visiting side.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Another one bites the dust! Keemo Paul was looking good but fails to stick around! An arm ball, full and on middle. Paul looks to reverse sweep it but misses and gets hit around his gloves. The ball lobs to the keeper who takes a couple of steps behind and takes it with ease. A huge appeal for caught behind but nothing given from the umpire and Pakistan take it upstairs. UltraEdge shows it came off the fore-arm glove and the on-field umpire has to change his decision. Out it is.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Haris b Mohammad Nawaz

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter and around off. Hosein now goes back and tucks it to mid-wicket for one.
Tossed up on middle. Hosein comes down the track and flicks it to short fine leg.
Length ball, around off. Paul punches it to deep covers where a little fumble allows a brace. Good over for West Indies as 14 runs come off it. 116 more needed.
Flatter and around off. Hosein pulls it to deep mid-wicket for one.
On middle, flicked to square leg for one more.
SIX! In the slot! This is full and on middle. Paul swings across and hits it over long on for a biggie.
Leg bye! On the pads. Hosein fails to flick it away and it goes off the pads to short fine leg for a single.
Shorter and outside off, a leggie. Paul pulls it to deep mid-wicket and Shah runs across and covers a lot of ground to cut it out. Two runs.
Length and on off, at 139 clicks, there is extra bounce and pace. Paul is hurried as he defends on the up to mid off and the batters take a quick single.
FOUR! On a length and on middle. Sits nicely for Paul who pulls it away to deep square leg for a boundary.
Length and on middle. Defended out.
BEATEN! This one just nips back in, on a length and outside off. Paul looks to push away from the body but gets beaten on the inside edge.
Wide! A half-tracker, angling on leg. Paul leaves it alone. A wide given for height.
Fuller and outside off, driven to deep covers for a single.
On a length and on off. Hosein shuffles across and blocks it out.
FOUR! Keemo Paul gets off the mark with a boundary. It is googly, around off. Keemo Paul gets low and reverse-sweeps it to third man for a boundary.
WOW! A beauty! Flighted and full, around off. Paul tries to defend it out on the front foot but misses. The ball zips past his outside edge.
Keemo Paul is the new man in.

OUT! STUMPED! Mohammad Haris is quick behind the stumps and break a crucial stand here. Shadab Khan does the trick again as he picks up his second wicket. It is tossed up, full and on off. Carty comes down the track and makes the mistake of playing across the line. The ball turns away a touch off the deck which beats Carty completely. Mohammad Haris makes no mistake behind the sticks.
Commentary.Howout: st Mohammad Haris b Shadab Khan

Commentary.Commentary: It is full and on middle and leg. Carty flicks it over mid-wicket for a brace.
Outside off, Carty drives it to cover.
A single now as this is worked down to long on.
Very full, on off. Hosein pushes it to mid off for a quick single.
WIDE! Back of a length, on off. Akeal Hosein leaves it alone. The ball goes over his head and the umpire signals a wide. West Indies now need a run a ball to get over the victory line.
A length ball, around off. Carty works it to fine leg off the inside edge. They take one.
A sharp bouncer this time, around off. Carty sways away from the line of the delivery.
Length ball, on off. Carty blocks it out. This has been a good positive phase for West Indies since the wicket of Powell.
FOUR! Just out of reach! This is full and outside off. Carty slashes and it flies past point fielder for a boundary.
Good length, outside off. Carty works it through backward point and gets back for the second run comfortably.

SIX! BANG! Akeal Hosein gets his second maximum of the chase. He has come out with intent. Hosein uses his feet to get to the pitch of the ball and tonks it over the bowler's head for a maximum. he couldn't have hit it any better.
On middle and leg. Carty works it to long on for a single.
On off, defended back to the bowler.
SIX! All the way! It is short and outside off. Carty goes back and smokes it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Full, on off. Carty defends it to covers.
Flatter and at the stumps. Hosein works it to long on for a single.
This one stays low, around the pads, Akeal Hosein clips it to mid-wicket for one. 9 runs off the over. West Indies need more overs like this one.
Looped up and full, outside off. Hosein dances down the track and hits it to mid off.
This is much quicker and on the stumps. Carty stays back to defend it out.
Swing and a miss! It is looped up, around off. Turns away a touch off the deck. Carty tries to go downtown but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Length, on the pads. Hosein tucks it to the leg side and rotates the strike.
SIX! BOOM! It is full and on off. Hosein comes down the track and smokes it over the long off fence for a maximum.
It is full and around off. This one turns away off the deck. Carty blocks it out watchfully. An incredible over by Khan.
Looped up, full and on off. Carty defends it back to the bowler.
Full and on off. Hosein eases it to the leg side for one run.
Akeal Hosein is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Shadab Khan gets himself into the wicket's column. It is tossed up, full and outside off. Powell gets under it and smacks it towards long off. He does not get the desired distance on it and holes out instead. A huge blow for West Indies as they lose their fifth wicket. Fakhar Zaman makes no mistake in the deep.
Commentary.Howout: c Fakhar Zaman b Shadab Khan

Commentary.Commentary: Floated and full, on off. Powell defends it out solidly.
Flatter and outside off. Powell defends it to covers.
On a length and outside off. Carty knocks it to covers.
Tossed up, slanting on leg. Powell wrists it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Angling on the pads, Powell fails to flick it away and gets hit on the pads.
Tossed up, quicker and outside off. Carty skips down and chips it in the air through covers for a single.
On top of off. Carty rocks back and defends this.
Fuller and on off. Carty steps forward and pushes it to mid off.
Tossed up on middle. Carty drills it to long on for one.
A single as this is hit to long on.
Flatter and on off, Powell bunts it behind square n the leg side for a brace.
On middle, nudged to square leg.

Four byes! Too full and on middle, it spins sharply away. Powell looks for a big booming drive but misses and it races to third man. The fielder gives a chase, slides and flicks away and the replay shows he touched the ropes.
Full and on middle, pushed to long on for a single.
Maiden for Mohammad Nawaz! Fuller and outside off. Powell drives it to point.
Full and outside off, pushed to covers.
Angles a length ball on middle. Kept out.
Flatter and outside off, spinning away. Powell pushes it to covers. Again Powell wants a single but is sent back.
Tossed up on middle. Blocked to covers.
Tad short and outside off. Powell punches it to covers.
Pushed quicker on the shorter side. Carty punches it late past short third man for a brace.
Too full and on middle, drilled down to long on for one.
Full and on off, pushed to covers.
Tossed up, outside off, turning away. Carty drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
On middle, punched to long on for a single.
FOUR! Khan is greeted with a four! Flatter and outside off. Powell cuts it hard to point where Shahnawaz Dahani runs across but fails to stop it.
Slides a full ball, on middle. Carty pushes it to mid off, he wants a single but was sent back from the halfway mark.
Fuller and on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Slightly short and outside off, punched to mid off.
Tossed up, on off, pushed back to Nawaz.
FOUR! An arm ball, full and on middle. Carty sweeps it to deep square leg for a boundary.
Rovman Powell is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Khushdil Shah once again with a tough catch! Pakistan have got another huge wicket here! Nawaz tosses it up nicely, full and on middle. Pooran comes down the track but fails to reach the pitch of the ball. He swings across and hits it high in the night sky, towards deep square leg where Khushdil Shah takes a skier.
Commentary.Howout: c Khushdil Shah b Mohammad Nawaz

Commentary.Commentary: Full and on the pads, Carty tucks it to mid-wicket, but is unable to find the gap.
On a length, outside off. Pooran guides it to third man for another single.
Touch short, on the bodyline. Carty tucks it to square leg for one.
Full length, on off. Pooran pushes it to mid off for one.
On a length, around off. Pooran greets it with full face of the blade.
A length ball, on off. Pooran blocks it to covers.

Drinks! Pakistan are dominating right now and they will be slightly relieved as they got rid of Hope and Brooks cheaply. They will look to continue taking wickets while West Indies will hope for a big partnership.
Full and on off, blocked out watchfully.
On the pads, tucked to the leg side.
Fuller, around off. Carty gets an inside edge onto his pads. This saves him.
On off,  blocked out.
Tossed up, full and on off. Nicholas Pooran heaves it across the line to deep mid-wicket but it lands safely. They take one.
Full and outside off. Carty eases it to deep point for one.
Wasim continues to go full and aims the pads yet again. Carty hangs back and tucks it through square leg for a single.
Full length, on middle and leg, defended out solidly.
Full length, angled into the pads. Carty squeezes it out in time.
Length ball, on the pads, Carty tucks it to mid-wicket.
Full length, wide outside off. Pooran drives it through covers for another single.
A length ball, on off. Carty pushes it to cover for a single.
Full length, outside off. Poorna defends it out watchfully.
FOUR! Nicely played. A length ball, on off. Pooran heaves it through mid-wicket for a boundary. He uses his feet really well this time.
Length, on off, blocked out.
Good length, outside off. Pooran pushes it past point for a couple.
Length, on off, defended out.
Ali goes full and on off. Carty pushes it to the right of mid off. Babar Azam there moves to his right and makes a brilliant stop with a dive. A single taken.
Wasim hits the hard length, on the bodyline. Carty stays back and pulls it through square leg for a single. Just 2 runs and a wicket off it. Pakistan dominating the proceeding.
A length ball, on off. Carty hangs back and blocks it to covers.
Full one. outside off. Pooran leans in and drives it through covers for a single.
Nicholas Pooran walks in.

OUT! TIMBER! Mohammad Wasim continues to attack the stumps and gets rewarded this time. Another one bites the dust for West Indies. It is a length ball, angled in on off. Shamarh Brooks stays behind to defend it out, but only manages to find an inside edge. The ball goes through to rattle the stumps. Pakistan right on top of the game now.
Full length, on the pads, Brooks works it to mid on.
Back of a length, on off. Brooks pushes it out to safety.
End of Powerplay 1! That means, now four fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle.
Length and on off. Defended to covers.
Keacy Carty comes in at number 4.

OUT! TAKEN! What a catch by Khushdil Shah and the skipper is the first one to run across and congratulate him. This is short and on middle. Hope pulls it nicely and to deep mid-wicket. It was almost going to the fence but Khushdil Shah runs across from square leg and takes it near the edge and keeps his cool to not touch the ropes. Excellent stuff from Shah and Pakistan have got the man in form for West Indies!
Commentary.Howout: c Khushdil Shah b Hasan Ali

Commentary.Commentary: Just a single! Short of a length, outside off, steep bounce. Brooks looks to defend but it goes off the shoulder of the bat and to third man for a single.
Another dot! Full and outside off, pushed to covers.
Length ball, around middle. Brooks steps across and eases it to mid on.
Length ball, around off. Blocked out.
On middle, length, worked to covers.
On the pads, flicked to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Good shot! Length ball on top of off. Hope hangs back and caresses it through gap, to covers for a boundary. 50 up for West Indies.
Length and on off, pushed to mid off.
Full and outside off, Brooks punches it to covers for one.
Length ball, outside off at 136.7 kph. Brooks has a poke at it but misses.
A length ball, outside off. Brooks splices his drive to third man for a single.
Short of a length, angling just around off. Brooks punches it to the left of mid off and comes back for the second.
Another back foot punch but this time straight to cover.
On a length and outside off. Brooks punches off the back foot through cover-point for a brace.
No runs in the last 10 balls! On a length and outside off. Blocked out.
On middle, tucked to mid-wcket.
A maiden for Mohammad Wasim! On a length and outside off, driven to mid off.
This is full and angling on middle. Hope flicks it to mid-wicket.
Four dots to start with for Wasim. Short in length and outside off. Hope feels for it and fails to connect.
Almost a yorker on middle. Hope gets his bat down on time and jams it out to point.
Short of a length on top of off. Hope taps it to point.
Starts with a full ball on off. Hope punches it back to Wasim.
Change. Mohammad Wasim comes into the attack now.
Again, this is outside off, on a length. Brooks leaves it.
Outside off. Left alone.
FOUR! This time with more control! Short of a length and outside off. Brooks climbs on top of the bounce and punches it through point for a boundary.
SIX! Edged away! Shorter and on middle. Brooks rides the pull and gets a top edge over the keeper and for a biggie.
This is full and outside off, pushed to mid off.
A length ball, outside off, no bounce there. Brooks swings and misses.
Fuller, outside off. Hope drives it towards covers but finds the fielder.
FOUR! Through the gap! It is short and outside off. Hope hangs back and crunches it through point for a boundary. Incredible shot. No chance for the fielder to stop it.
Length ball, outside off. Brooks stays back and defends it to backward point for a single.
LEG BYE! A length ball now, this one nips back in. Hope gets it to the off side off the pads. They collect a leg bye.
Two dots to start with! This is full and on off. Hope punches it straight to the cover fielder.
Full length, on middle and leg. Hope clips it to mid-wicket but unable to find the gap.
Length and on off. Brooks defends it out watchfully. A successful over by Dahani comes to an end.
Back of a length, outside off. This one flies off the deck. Shamarh Brooks tries to punch it away on the back foot but only collects with thin air.
Length ball, on off, blocked out.
On a length, outside off. Brooks lets it be.
Shamarh Brooks is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT! A stunning catch by Imam-ul-Haq and Kyle Mayers is unable to find any other loop holes to stay at the crease. It is a short ball, just outside off. It gets big on Kyle Mayers, who looks to cut it away but gets it to fly off the outer half. Imam-ul-Haq dives to his right at point to take an incredible catch. Shahnawaz Dahani is surely pumped up here and why wouldn't he be. This is his first ODI wicket for Pakistan.
Length ball, on off. Hope taps it through point for a single.
Good length, outside off. Mayers looks to chase it but misses it completely.
Full length, angled in on off. Mayers defends it out.
FOUR BYES! It is full and angled down leg. Kyle Mayers moves to the leg side and tries to work it away but misses. It beats the keeper as well to run down to the fence at fine leg.
Mayers is just told to wait as the third umpire checks a front foot no ball. It is a no ball and Kyle Mayers survives.

Hasan Ali draws the first blood here. He is into his celebration in no time. HOLD ON! The third umpire has a look at the front foot but does not seem to be satisifed by it as Ali has overstepped. His celebration has been cut short. Free hit to follow. Can Mayers make the most of his lifeline?
A length ball, on the pads, Hope tucks it to mid-wicket for a quick single.
Length ball, outside off. Hope pushes it to the off side.
FOUR! UP AND OVER! It is full and outside off. Hope stays back and lofts it over covers for a boundary. Hope is off to a great start.

A loud appeal for caught behind by Shahnawaz Dahani. The umpire is not interested at all. It is a length ball, that lands around off and nips away off the deck. Kyle Mayers looks to defend it out but plays inside the line.
FOUR! Incredible shot! Kyle Mayers gets his first boundary of the chase. Shorter, wide outside off. Mayers slaps it through the gap at covers for four.
Four dots in a row! A great start by Shahnawaz Dahani. Good length, wide outside off. Mayers stays back and crunches it straight to point.
Touch shorter, outside off. Mayers shoulders his arms at it.
Dahani extracts some extra bounce off the deck. It is a length ball, angled across the left-hander. Mayers tries to cut it away but gets beaten on the outside edge.
